tools.name: company_facts

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plan_roof · Private data: roof_report_pdf, roof_report_pdf_start, roof_report_pdf_file, roof_picture_file · Public sink: area_figures, plan_roof, compare_plans, consultation_link · Destructive: edit_roof, sun_tomorrow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plan_roof · Private data: roof_report_pdf, roof_report_pdf_start, roof_report_pdf_file, roof_picture_file · Public sink: area_figures, plan_roof, compare_plans, consultation_link · Destructive: edit_roof, sun_tomorrow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
